newsitem.title: USA: DynaGen gets FDA 510k nod for NicCheck I.
newsitem.headline: DynaGen gets FDA 510k nod for NicCheck I.

text.p: DynaGen Inc said Monday it has received 510k marketing approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for NicCheck I, the company's nicotine measurement device.

NicCheck I is the first test that measures a body's nicotine content with a urine sample, according to a company spokeswoman, who said that other tests measure only carbon monoxide levels, not nicotine levels.
The test takes 15 minutes to complete and will be available to physicians at a cost of $2, the spokeswoman said.
The company currently is also developing NicCheck II, which is intended to measure the level of nicotine from second-hand smoke, the spokeswoman said.
The company will hold a briefing in Washington, on Tuesday to announce the approval, she said.
